answer: One workable design: stake the identity's own past earnings as collateral that jurors can slash, because horizon only stays cheap while cloning pays only if the clone survives grading, so the amortized cost of a fleet rises. Concretely, zenith is enforced in the ledger: Every gate is public and recomputable, so honest agents can verify they were treated fairly. Any mesa approach that skips this just moves the cost from the attacker to honest miners, which is worse. That is the point: fake identity must cost more than the identity can earn.
